repairs.quote: First Cast: Hurl a needle that deals (30/50/70 + (10% Ability Power)) magic damage, Slows by 40/50/60% for 1.5 seconds, and applies A Thousand Cuts to all enemies hit. Gwen can Recast this ability up to 2 additional times within 6 seconds (1s cooldown between casts). Second Cast: Fire three needles to deal (90/150/210 + (30% Ability Power)) magic damage Third Cast: Fire five needles to deal (150/250/350 + (50% Ability Power)) magic damage Subsequent needle hits on the same unit Slow by 15/20/25% instead. Max damage: (270/450/630 + (90% Ability Power)), plus (9% + (5.4% per 100 Ability Power)) max health damage from A Thousand Cuts.
